`enum Platform`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.utils.platform` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [Platform.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/utils/platform/Platform.java)

Operating system that JOID runs on, and where it keeps its cache there.

## Learn more

- [Where JOID stores files](/use/learn/running/files/)

## Creation

| Returns | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`Platform`](/reference/utilities/platform/) | [current](#Platform-factory-current)() <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span> | Returns the system named by the `os.name` property: macOS for a name with `mac` or `darwin`, Windows for a name with `win`, Linux otherwise. |

<a id="Platform-methods"></a>

| Returns | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `boolean` | [is64Bit](#Platform-method-is64Bit)() <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span> | If `true`, the `os.arch` property names a 64-bit architecture. |
| `File` | [getCacheDir](#Platform-method-getCacheDir)(String home, Function<String,String> environment) | Returns the cache folder of the user of the folder `home` on this system, reading the environment variables through `environment`: `%LOCALAPPDATA%` (or `AppData/Local`) on Windows, `Library/Caches` on macOS, `$XDG_CACHE_HOME` (or `.cache`) on Linux. |

## Creation details

<a id="Platform-factory-current"></a>

### current

`Platform current()` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Returns the system named by the `os.name` property: macOS for a name with `mac` or `darwin`, Windows for a name with `win`, Linux otherwise.

## Method details

<a id="Platform-method-is64Bit"></a>

### is64Bit

`boolean is64Bit()` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

If `true`, the `os.arch` property names a 64-bit architecture.

<a id="Platform-method-getCacheDir"></a>

### getCacheDir

`File getCacheDir(String home, Function<String,String> environment)` 

Returns the cache folder of the user of the folder `home` on this system, reading the environment variables through `environment`: `%LOCALAPPDATA%` (or `AppData/Local`) on Windows, `Library/Caches` on macOS, `$XDG_CACHE_HOME` (or `.cache`) on Linux.
